column3: hard to please, hard to worship
in the form of divine maya
at the end of life, at death
on the lap of the earth
fallen from the wish-fulfilling tree of the Vedas
of the remains of an offering (nirmalya)
even freedom from action, without devotion to Achyuta
in the state of being a husband
under the weight of the feet
in truth, from the highest point of view
of the one whose fame is holy
in the form of a son
of the birth of a son
in the blossoming groves and gardens, sounding with birds and bees
O best of the Puru line
by rising, seats and so on (courtesies)
of those who have taken refuge
going forth, without a duty done, the uninitiated
in the body of a living being
here deceit is wholly cast out
in the Lord, the Self of all
of the river of worldly existence
remover of the fear of existence
in the forest of worldly existence
of the one made of beings
of Kamadeva (the one with the crocodile banner)
Mihirvan (a name of Shiva?, the bountiful)
by whose sidelong glance of release
O great heroes of the Yadus
in the conversation with the messengers of Yama
by kings who have not conquered themselves
in clothes, ornaments and so on
the finding of the brahmanas' curse
fixing the mind on the Self after letting go
the deeds of the one of infinite valour
taking the form of a bull
in the Vaiyasiki Samhita of eighteen thousand
